name: Cute Cute Dakishimete!!
source:
Protagonist is a 3rd year high school student, but he is already engaged since the childhood. During summer holidays a cute girl suddenly visits his house and somehow they spend night together. He feels easy next to her, but he's also looking forward to his marriage with the engaged girl. This summer will be hot!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是高中三年级学生，却从小就已有婚约。暑假期间，一位可爱的女孩突然来到他家，不知怎的，两人共度了一夜。与她相处令他感到自在，但他也一直期待着与未婚妻成婚。这个夏天注定火热！

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
